name: Chiwa Freeman
source:
Growing up in a strict, religious environment, Chiwa spends most of her time attending church and trying to keep the wild and adventurous Oluchi in line. She seeks approval from her loved ones but also wants to live her own life.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
